meta.title: Dandy Abadie — Full-Stack Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Dandy Abadie Atoche, full-stack developer and creator of ExitoCoach. Java, Spring Boot, React, React Native and Next.js.

hero.subheadline: Brazilian full-stack developer, currently based in Peru. I turn ideas into fast, good-looking products that solve real problems.

about.title: A bit of my story
about.paragraph1: I'm from Brazil, currently living in Peru, where I study Systems Engineering at Universidad Tecnológica del Perú. I've always been the type who learns on my own — besides university, I study by myself every day because growth doesn't have an expiration date.
about.paragraph2: I love turning ideas into real products: from online stores to personal-organization apps. Every new project is an excuse to learn a different technology.

venture.title: ExitoCoach
venture.description: A company I founded to build a personal-growth app: notes, reminders, expense tracking, and a 'life compass' that shows you where you want to go. Still in development — coming soon.
